Reference

No orthographic source exists for this prop -- every dimension beyond the official envelope is a flagged visual estimate, not a measurement. The open-mechanism photo is the primary construction evidence: it directly shows this is a hinged two-part assembly, not a continuous shell.

Model views

Material-lit renders of the current committed state (decision_revision 6). Both orthographic, matching this run's own camera convention.

Surface and construction evidence

Isolated single-object renders, since the assembled iso view hides the recess and throat behind the taller lever. Every one of these three features required a real, documented bug fix before it matched intent -- see the run's README for the full chain.

Components and construction log

Two primary objects so far; the separate mechanism parts (anvil plate, magazine rail, hinge pin, latch, spring, base pad) haven't been added yet.

BaseShell_HIGHbox + front anvil/staple-channel recess190.5 x 63.5 x 14.25 mm, length/width exact from spec

Known uncertainties

Open by design, not by oversight.

  • No orthographic reference existsEvery proportion beyond the official 7.5 x 2.5 x 1.7 in envelope (base/lever height split, hinge gap size, crown depth, anvil recess position) is a visual estimate from oblique photos, not a measurement.
  • No nose/front taper on the lever yetThe reference shows the lever's front tip sloping down toward the base; the current model's front end is still a flat vertical face.
  • No separate mechanism components yetAnvil plate, magazine rail, hinge pin, latch, spring, and rubber base pad are all still absent -- primary cages only at this stage.
  • This run hit and fixed three real construction bugsA local-vs-world coordinate mismatch that inverted the anvil recess and no-oped the hinge throat, then a crown-rounding bug with the same root cause plus a backwards drop direction. All documented and fixed in the README, but worth a second look given how many places this bug class could have hidden.

Review questions

Answer inline as a comment on this artifact, or reply in chat.

  1. Does it read as a stapler at all yet, at this primary-cage stage?
  2. Is the base-to-lever height ratio plausible, given no source gives this split directly?
  3. Does the hinge gap/throat look like the right general shape and size?
  4. Does the lever's domed crown look right, or too round / too flat / too faceted for this stage?
  5. Is the anvil recess in a plausible position and size?
  6. Any major proportion that's obviously wrong, independent of the above?
